hero.subtitle: I build apps on web and mobile — from zero, in one week, powered by AI tools that compress months of engineering into a single focused sprint.

how.label: / how it works
how.title: One week, three phases.
how.intro: The 7-day cycle is engineered into a tight, predictable rhythm — so you always know what's happening and what's next.

phases.title: Discover & design
phases.body: I define the scope, map the user flow, and lock the architecture. AI helps draft specs, generate copy, and validate ideas before a single line of code.

phases.title: Build & synthesize
phases.body: The app takes shape fast. AI-assisted scaffolding, generated components, and automated tests turn the blueprint into working software — iterated daily.

phases.title: Launch & hand-off
phases.body: I polish, deploy, and hand over a live product with docs. What started as nothing is now a real app, shipped in exactly one week.

mission.label: / mission
paragraphs: fromzero.ro exists to prove that software doesn't need months of ceremony. With the right orchestration of AI tools, a focused idea can become a shipped product in seven days.
The mission is simple: turn the void between "I have an idea" and "I have an app" into a single, deliberate week of velocity.
Every build ships as both a web and a mobile version. AI agents are integrated where they add real value — not as a gimmick, but as part of the product's core logic.
mission.equation: Human direction + machine execution = shipped software.

whoami.label: / who am I
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer and engineering leader based in Cluj-Napoca, with 25 years of experience building navigation, infotainment, mobile and cloud products — from Nokia handsets and PDAs to Ford SYNC 4 in-car systems.

Along the way I've been developer, team lead, Scrum Master, engineering manager and Director of Engineering at Telenav, leading teams of up to 20 engineers across Android, iOS, web and cloud. I'm also a collaborator of the Technical University of Cluj-Napoca.
fromzero.ro is where that experience meets AI tooling: senior-level architecture, code reviews and quality standards — delivered in a week, not a quarter.

deliverables.label: / deliverables
paragraphs: By day 7 you don't get a prototype or a slide deck — you get a shipped product, the keys to it, and the support to keep it running.
Everything is yours: the code, the project, the deployments. I hand over and step back, on your terms.
items: Live web app
Installable Android & iOS builds (APK / TestFlight)
Full source code
Setup & usage docs
14 days of bug fixes

scope.label: / scope
scope.intro: Honest boundaries keep the one-week model real. Here's what a single sprint can deliver, and what needs a longer runway.

needs.label: / your part
needs.intro: A one-week build is a team effort. These few things on your side are what make the deadline possible.

items.title: One decision-maker
items.body: A single person who can approve the scope and give feedback, so decisions take minutes, not meetings.

items.title: Replies within 24 hours
items.body: During the build week, questions get answered the same or the next day. A short daily check-in keeps us in sync.

items.title: Accounts in your name
items.body: Domain, hosting, Apple & Google developer accounts, and any paid services (AI, payments) — set up before day 1. Apple's approval alone can take a few days.

items.title: Content & branding
items.body: Logo, colors, texts and images. If they're not ready, I'll use clean placeholders you can swap later.

items.title: A frozen scope
items.body: Once the build starts, new ideas go on a v2 list instead of into this week. That's what keeps the 7 days real.

items.title: Testing on days 6–7
items.body: Time to try the app yourself and confirm the hand-off, so launch day has no surprises.

needs.note: If something on your side is delayed, the delivery date moves by the same amount, never the quality.

pricing.intro: No hourly billing and no advance payment. Once we've agreed on the scope, you get a fixed price for the entire build, and you pay only when your app is live and handed over to you.

privacy.label: / privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what personal data fromzero.ro collects, why, and what control you have over it, in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: What we collect
items: **Project requests.** When you use the “Start your project” form: your name, your email address and the project description you write, together with the date and time of the request and the IP address it was sent from.
**Technical logs.** Like any web server, ours records basic request data (IP address, browser type, page requested, time) to keep the site secure and working.
**Emails.** If you write to us, we keep the correspondence.

sections.title: Why we use it and on what legal basis
items: To reply to your request, discuss the scope and prepare an offer: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
To protect the site against abuse (for example, limiting repeated form submissions): our legitimate interest in keeping the service secure (Art. 6(1)(f)).
If we work together, to deliver the project, invoice and meet our legal accounting obligations (Art. 6(1)(b) and 6(1)(c)).

sections.title: What we don't do
items: No cookies, no analytics, no tracking pixels and no advertising. The only thing stored in your browser is your language choice.
We never sell your data and never use it for newsletters you didn't ask for.
No automated decision-making or profiling.

sections.title: Who processes it
items: **Contabo GmbH** (Germany): hosts the website, the form data and our email server, inside the EU.
**Google**: request notifications are also delivered to a Gmail inbox. Google may process data outside the EU under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses.
**Google Fonts**: the site loads its fonts from Google's servers, which receive your IP address when the page loads.

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: Project requests that don't lead to a collaboration: up to 12 months, then deleted.
Data from projects we work on: for the duration of the project, plus the period required by Romanian accounting law for invoices and contracts.
Server logs: up to 14 days.

sections.title: Your rights
items: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, restrict or object to its processing, or receive it in a portable format. Just write to [{email}](mailto:{email}); we reply within 30 days.
You also have the right to complain to the Romanian data protection authority, ANSPDCP ([dataprotection.ro](https://www.dataprotection.ro)).
